晚饭后，六个人围坐在长条桌前。宿舍里的灯不太亮，光线昏黄昏黄的。走廊里有人走来走去，脚步声和说话声断断续续地传进来。

刘卫东趴在桌上写那篇一千字的心得体会，咬着钢笔，半天憋不出一个字。稿纸上写了划，划了写，揉了好几个纸团了。他一会儿抓耳挠腮，一会儿翻翻伟人著作，嘴里念念有词，就是凑不够字数。

赵振国在预习解剖课的内容，用钢笔在笔记本上画人体骨骼图。他画得很认真，颅骨画了个圆，下颌骨画了个半圆，肋骨画了几道弧线。虽然画得不太像，但标注写得清楚——额骨、顶骨、枕骨、颞骨，一一标出来。

陈志远在那翻那本《赤脚医生手册》，看得入了迷。他一边看一边在纸上记，什么草药治什么病，什么穴位管什么痛，记得密密麻麻。

林大山靠在床头，默默抽着烟。他抽烟的姿势很老练，两根手指夹着烟，深吸一口，停几秒，再慢慢吐出来。烟雾在灯泡周围缭绕，像一层薄纱。他眼睛半睁半闭，不知道在想什么。

郭大江蹲在地上，一直在擦他那双皮鞋。皮鞋是部队发的，黑色系带，他擦得很仔细，先拿湿布擦掉灰，再拿干布抛光，最后挤上鞋油，用刷子来回刷。鞋油的味道混着烟味，在宿舍里飘着。

王建新从挎包里掏出那本《外科病理学》，放在桌上。书皮是深蓝色的，磨损得厉害，边角都白了，但书脊上的字还能看清。

“你从哪搞的？”刘卫东凑过来看了一眼，眼睛都瞪圆了，“这可是正规教材啊！咱们发的油印本跟这个没法比。你看这厚度，这印刷，这纸张——”

“碰巧遇到一个老师，他借给我的。”王建新没说太多，翻开书，看了几页。

林大山从床头探过头来看了一眼书名，哼了一声，压低了声音说：“你当心点，这种书现在算封资修的东西，让人发现了不好。”

“看个书能有什么问题？”赵振国推了推眼镜，不以为然。

“就怕有人借题发挥啊。”林大山吐了口烟，“咱们现在学什么，不学什么，都是有讲究的。你多看了一页，少看了一页，都可能被人拿来说事。”

宿舍里安静了下来。刘卫东不写了，赵振国不画了，陈志远合上了书。几个人你看看我，我看看你，都不说话了。

王建新把那本书收进挎包里。

郭大江突然开口了。他把皮鞋放下，坐在地上，看了看屋里的五个人，声音不大，但说得很慢：“咱们从不同的地方来，能坐在这间屋子里就是缘分。学得成学不成，先交个朋友。以后不管遇到什么事，能搭把手的尽量搭把手。”

这话说得朴实，但分量很重。

刘卫东第一个拍桌子：“对！以后咱们就是兄弟，有福同享，有难同当。”

陈志远也点了点头。赵振国推了推眼镜，笑了。林大山把烟掐灭，没说什么，但嘴角动了一下。

接着有人提议排一下老大、老二、老三。按年龄排，按军龄排，按职务排，争了几句。

赵振国推了推眼镜，说了一句：“咱们是军人，这样不合适吧？”

大家便不再吱声了。军人讲的是职务、组织纪律，不搞江湖那一套。排老大老二，那是老百姓的玩法。

刘卫东换了个话题，问王建新：“队长，我听说不是咱们应该在学校待半年，再去下面工厂公社开门办学吗？为啥这次把你们这一组派出去了？这才开学几天呀？”

大家都不知道为什么会这么安排。王建新也不知道。但上面这么安排了，身为军人只能执行命令。他想了想，说：“可能是试点，也可能是别的什么原因。不管怎样，去了就好好干，到了下面也是一样学。”

王建新看了看手表，对一班长林大山和二班长赵振国说：“熄灯前，你俩去查寝。郭大江去通知三班长王招娣，女兵那边你也查一下。熄灯后一个小时，郭大江和我再查一遍。”

“是！”三人应了一声，出去了。

之后的几天，每天早操、上课。日子过得像钟摆一样准时——六点起床，六点半出操，八点上课，十二点午饭，下午两点上课，五点下课，晚饭，晚自习，九点半熄灯。

After dinner, six people sat around the long table.The lights in the dormitory are not very bright, and the light is dim.Someone was walking up and down in the corridor, and the sound of footsteps and voices came intermittently.

Liu Weidong was lying on the table writing the thousand-word article about his thoughts and feelings. He bit his pen and couldn't hold back a single word for a long time.I wrote on the manuscript paper, scratched it, and crumpled it into several paper balls.He scratched his head and scratched his head for a while, flipped through the works of great men, and muttered words, but he just couldn't make up the number of words.

Zhao Zhenguo is previewing the content of anatomy class, using a pen to draw a diagram of the human skeleton in his notebook.He drew very carefully, drawing a circle for the skull, a semicircle for the mandible, and several arcs for the ribs.Although the drawings don't look alike, the labels are clearly written - the frontal bones, parietal bones, occipital bones, and temporal bones are marked one by one.

Chen Zhiyuan was flipping through the "Barefoot Doctor's Handbook" and was fascinated by it.As he read, he wrote down on paper which herbal medicines could cure which diseases, which acupuncture points dealt with which pains, and he remembered them densely.

Lin Dashan leaned on the bedside and smoked silently.His smoking posture is very sophisticated. He holds the cigarette between two fingers, takes a deep breath, pauses for a few seconds, and then spits it out slowly.Smoke curled around the bulb like a veil.His eyes were half open and half closed, not knowing what he was thinking.

Guo Dajiang squatted on the ground and kept polishing his leather shoes.The leather shoes were issued by the army and had black laces. He wiped them carefully. He first wiped off the dust with a wet cloth, then polished them with a dry cloth. Finally, he squeezed on shoe polish and brushed them back and forth with a brush.The smell of shoe polish mixed with the smell of cigarette smoke floated in the dormitory.

Wang Jianxin took out the "Surgical Pathology" from his satchel and placed it on the table.The book cover is dark blue, badly worn, and the corners are white, but the words on the spine can still be read clearly.

"Where did you get it?" Liu Weidong came over and took a look, his eyes widened, "This is a formal textbook! The mimeographed books we distributed are incomparable to this. Look at the thickness, the printing, the paper -"

"I happened to meet a teacher and he lent it to me." Wang Jianxin opened the book and read a few pages without saying much.

Lin Dashan leaned his head over the bed and glanced at the title of the book. He snorted and lowered his voice and said, "Be careful. This kind of book is now regarded as a scholar's book. It's not good for people to find out."

"What's wrong with reading a book?" Zhao Zhenguo pushed up his glasses and disagreed.

"I'm afraid that someone will use the topic to make use of it." Lin Dashan puffed out smoke, "What we learn now and what we don't learn are all very particular. If you read one more page or one less page, someone may make excuses for it."

The dormitory became quiet.Liu Weidong stopped writing, Zhao Zhenguo stopped painting, and Chen Zhiyuan closed the book.Several people looked at me and I looked at you, but they didn't say anything.

Wang Jianxin put the book into his satchel.

Guo Dajiang suddenly spoke.He put down his leather shoes, sat on the ground, looked at the five people in the room, and said in a low voice but very slowly: "We are from different places, and it is fate that we can sit in this room. If you are successful in learning, you must first make a friend. No matter what happens in the future, try to help those who can help."

This is a simple statement, but it carries a heavy weight.

Liu Weidong was the first to slap the table: "Yes! From now on, we will be brothers, sharing blessings and suffering together."

Chen Zhiyuan also nodded.Zhao Zhenguo pushed up his glasses and smiled.Lin Dashan put out his cigarette and said nothing, but the corner of his mouth moved.

Then someone suggested ranking the boss, second, and third.Ranked by age, ranked by military age, ranked by position, and argued a few words.

Zhao Zhenguo pushed up his glasses and said, "We are soldiers, isn't this inappropriate?"

Everyone stopped talking.Soldiers talk about duties and organizational discipline, not the trappings of martial arts.Ranking first and second in line is the common people's way of playing.

Liu Weidong changed the topic and asked Wang Jianxin: "Captain, I heard that we should stay in school for half a year before going to the factory and commune down below to open the school? Why did your group be sent out this time? How many days has school started?"

No one knows why this arrangement was made.Wang Jianxin doesn’t know either.But the above arrangements are such that as a soldier, you can only execute orders.He thought for a moment and said, "It may be a pilot project, or it may be for other reasons. No matter what, just work hard when you go there, and you will learn the same thing when you get down there."

Wang Jianxin looked at his watch and said to the first squad leader Lin Dashan and the second squad leader Zhao Zhenguo: "Before lights out, you two go check the bed. Guo Dajiang goes to inform the third squad leader Wang Zhaodi, and you also check the female soldiers. One hour after lights out, Guo Dajiang and I check again."

"Yes!" The three of them responded and went out.

In the next few days, I did morning exercises and classes every day.The days pass like a pendulum on time - get up at six o'clock, go to exercise at six thirty, go to class at eight o'clock, lunch at twelve o'clock, class at two o'clock in the afternoon, end class at five o'clock, dinner, evening self-study, lights out at nine thirty.
